sources.citation: 'MPPT Solar Charge Controller MODBUS Protocol' (English version), 15 pp., no manufacturer named, PDF created 2021-07-07 — https://github.com/krahabb/esphome-easun-6048/blob/main/components/m3_easun6048/docs/MPPT%20MODBUS
SRNE_MODBUS Protocol V3.9, 2020-04-21, SRNE Solar Co. Ltd — already committed at docs/srne-modbus-protocol-v3.9.pdf (used here only as the contrasting map)

transport: Modbus RTU. Function codes 03H read, 06H write single, 10H write N, plus vendor codes 78H restore factory defaults and 79H clear history; error code = function code \| 80H. Slave address range 01H-F7H with 00H broadcast, and the device address lives at register 0x0201. Frame delimited by >10 ms idle. BAUD RATE, PARITY, STOP BITS, ELECTRICAL INTERFACE AND DEFAULT SLAVE ID ARE NOT STATED ANYWHERE IN
blocks: 0x000C-0x0013 product alias (16 ASCII) · 0x0014-0x0017 firmware/hardware version, production year/month · 0x0100-0x0113 real-time · 0x0120 load force-on (write) · 0x0201-0x0211 controller settings · 0x0300-0x0310 street-lamp parameters · 0x0400-0x042C 300-day history
gotchas: NO MODEL IS ASSIGNED TO THIS DIALECT ON PURPOSE. The document is committed in krahabb/esphome-easun-6048 as 'MPPT MODBUS Protocol - English Version.pdf' and referenced only as a source of 'hints'. Its PDF metadata is Title 'PDU地址' (PDU address), Author 'Administrator', Creator 'WPS 文字', dated 2021-07-07. A text search

IT IS DEMONSTRABLY NOT THE SRNE MAP, so the forum claim that 'MakeskyBlue, PowMR or EASUN Solar Charge Controllers are all re-brands of SRNE' cannot be used to reach for docs/srne-modbus-protocol-v3.9.pdf. Compared directly: SRNE puts SOC at 0x0100, battery voltage 0x0101, charge current 0x0102, temperatures 0x0103, lo

Where they DO agree is the charge-stage encoding: 0 none, 1 activated/open, 2 MPPT, 3 equalize, 4 boost, 5 float, 6 current-limit. Both documents list it identically. That is the one field a driver could share.

INTERNAL CONTRADICTION IN THE DOCUMENT: register 0x0104 is described as 'Charging power' but its Unit column reads 'A', not 'W'. The neighbouring 0x0108 'Street lamp (load) power' correctly reads 'W'. One of the two is a typo and the document does not resolve it. Do not assume.

There is no PV current register. 0x0103 is the charger's output current into the battery and 0x0104 its output power — same trap as EPEver 0x3105/0x3106: never negative, so they cannot express a bank being discharged, and they are not array-side figures. pv-power is deliberately omitted from reports for this reason.
unmappedReports: 0x0100 configured system nominal voltage (12/24/36/48 V) — a rating, not a measurement., 0x010A maximum charging power of the day (W) — no MetricKind for a daily peak., 0x010C DC-load energy consumed today (Wh) — pv-energy-today is solar-side and ac-energy-today is AC; there is no DC-load-energy-today metric., 0x0112/0x0113 lifetime DC-load energy consumed (32-bit Wh) — same gap on the lifetime side., 0x010F total operating days — Uptime is seconds since the device last restarted, which is a different quantity., 0x010D high byte: street-lamp dimming level 0-100 % — switch-state is boolean and cannot carry a brightness., 0x010E fault/alarm bitmask, 13 defined bits (battery over-discharge, battery over-voltage, low-voltage alarm, load short circuit, load over-power/open circuit, controller over-temperature, ambient over-temperature, input over-power, input short circuit, PV over-voltage, PV reverse polarity, battery reverse polarity) — no MetricKind carries faults., 0x0105 high byte controller internal temperature — MetricKind::Temperature is documented as *ambient* temperature. Reporting the controller's own die temperature under it repeats the EPEver 0x3111 mistake the catalogue already warns about., Daily history record fields sMaxBatVolt, sMinBatVolt, sMaxChargeWH, sLoad_W_H_Today and the 300-day ring buffer at 0x0400+ — no MetricKind expresses a per-day historical extreme., 0x0116/0x0117-equivalents are absent here, but 0x0202-0x0211 expose battery type, system voltage, six charge setpoint voltages, equalize/boost durations, equalize interval, temperature compensation coefficient and load working mode. Only set-charge-current-limit and start-equalize exist in CommandKind and neither is settable here, so every one of these is an unmapped write., 78H restore-factory-defaults has no CommandKind and probably should not get one.
